predecessor.change_scope: Evaluator chronology and evidence envelopes only; learner, operational material, methods and scoring are unchanged.

question_selection.policy: Select the sole next_day_sample_sales finding only when a validated served_item relationship and exactly one validated operational sales layout support the same dynamic unit; otherwise return UNKNOWN.

normalization.aggregation: sum admitted finite record values within the exact committed entity/location/one-day cohort

prediction.target: next-day admitted sample sales greater than or equal to the discovery-derived arithmetic-mean threshold
prediction.cohort: tenant/company entity-location and one-day UTC window
prediction.commitment: durable before release of the matching future operational records

revision.rule: (1 + resolved positive development outcomes) / (2 + resolved development outcomes)

scoring.comparison: frozen prior and revised methods on identical resolved later cohorts, outcomes, evidence, units and horizons

synthetic_chronology.domain: Synthetic experiment time only; it is not evidence of authorship, receipt, review or controller wall-clock chronology.

real_chronology.required_order: evaluator freeze receipt <= independent review <= controller-recorded run start
real_chronology.original_preparation: May be UNKNOWN with a non-empty reason and no timestamp; no sentinel or receipt timestamp substitutes for an unknown original time.
real_chronology.clock_boundary: Local controller timestamps and hashes evidence observed receipt and integrity only; they do not authenticate authorship, reviewer identity, independence or trusted time.

material_identity.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, comma/colon separators and non-finite numbers forbidden
material_identity.dataset_id: dataset- plus the first 32 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over canonical JSON of {package_version, protocol, material_sha256}
material_identity.raw_file_sha256: Binds the exact received package bytes separately from canonical material identity.
